core_obligations: With standard Bernoulli/polylogarithm identities, Hadamard products and multiple-sine/quantum-dilogarithm formulas supplied, the author must establish the actual NS Borel kernel and its branch/pole continuation, deform contours through an infinite singular-ray arrangement, match the real-ray Borel sum with an analytic nonperturbative special-function solution, and control infinite Stokes-jump sums in the distinct accumulation-ray domains. The epsilon-potential relation must then match sectorial jumps and base-sector normalization, and the same kernel yields exact WKB solutions and the free-energy/WKB bridge with its trajectory/pole exclusions. The complete analytic/sectorial correspondence, including the technical appendices, is oneH3 framework; individual formal shifts, scalar residues and recurrence/convergence support cards are not separate counts. Physical/higher-genus interpretations remain at author granularity.
